sources.entry: Papermerge - Document management system focused on scanned documents (electronic archives). Features file browsing in similar way to dropbox/google drive. OCR, full text search, text overlay/selection. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Papermerge OSS is a self-hosted, community-maintained document management system for scanned documents, with OCR, full-text search, tags, folders and a desktop-style web UI.
summary.what_it_does: Extracts text from scanned documents using OCR and indexes them for full-text search. Provides a web UI with a dual-panel, desktop-like file browser supporting drag and drop, hierarchical folders, and colored tags on documents or folders. Supports PDF, TIFF, JPEG and PNG files, with document versioning and page management (delete, reorder, cut, move, extract pages). Offers multi-user access with group ownership and sharing of documents and folders between users or groups. Includes an OpenAPI-compliant REST API, document types with custom metadata fields, and downloads with an OCRed text overlay. The UI is available in multiple languages.
use_cases: organize documents in folders and tags
share document folders with team members
how_to_run: Development setup (PostgreSQL, environment variables, backend and frontend, tests, CLI) is described in CONTRIBUTING.md
notable: Desktop-like dual-panel web UI with drag and drop
OCR with OCRed text overlay in downloads
Page-level management: cut, move, extract, reorder pages
Document versioning and custom fields per document type
caveats: The README's quick-start uses placeholder secret key and password that must be replaced for real deployments
Papermerge Cloud (SaaS) is a separate codebase; features and release schedules may differ from this edition
Development setup requires PostgreSQL and a backend/frontend toolchain, documented separately in CONTRIBUTING.md
